options: Storing data in a bank vault
Generating revenue from data
Converting currency values in a database
Paying for cloud storage
Charging employees for data access
questions.explanation: Monetisation is generating benefit, revenue or profit from anything; Data Monetisation is about generating revenue from data.

questions.stem: How do free social media platforms such as WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok and Instagram generate money, according to I Am Datapedia!?
options: Through government grants
By charging a hidden monthly fee
By selling hardware devices
By Data Monetisation, selling data generated by their customers
By donations from users
questions.explanation: Platforms that charge their customers nothing run their business through Data Monetisation: they sell the data that their customers generate.

questions.stem: What restriction do regulations place on platforms that monetise customer data?
options: They cannot share personal details of their customers with anyone
They cannot record what customers buy
They cannot analyse product trends
They cannot sell aggregated viewing statistics
They cannot operate in more than one country
questions.explanation: Regulations prevent platforms from sharing customers' personal details, but they can still sell information such as how many people view, buy or spend on which category and from which location.

questions.stem: In the Amazon example, which information is described as gold for product owners?
options: The names and addresses of individual customers
The passwords of customer accounts
Which and how many products will be in demand next December, based on the trend of the last few years
The salaries of Amazon employees
The location of Amazon warehouses
questions.explanation: Amazon can sell information on which and how many products will be in demand in the coming December based on previous years' trends; product owners can then plan raw materials, workforce and timelines.

questions.stem: Which of the following must be in place before a company can seriously monetise its data?
options: A social media account
A physical shop
A printed product catalogue
A team of external consultants
Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, a Data Dictionary and a Business Glossary
questions.explanation: Data Monetisation is the end product; to get there a company needs Data Governance, Data Quality, MDM, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Dictionary, Business Glossary and similar measures in place.

questions.stem: What is Data as a Service, as a method of generating revenue from data?
options: Making data available to clients via API or online data
Selling monthly KPI aggregations
Selling predictions from machine learning models
Reducing operational cost through data management
Providing free data to marketing
questions.explanation: Data as a Service means making data available to clients via an API or as online data.

questions.stem: How does Insight as a Service differ from Data as a Service?
options: It provides raw data via API
It is free of charge
It provides aggregations or KPIs on a monthly or annual basis rather than raw data
It only works on unstructured data
It is delivered on paper
questions.explanation: Insight as a Service provides aggregated or KPI-based insight on a monthly or annual basis via API, website or mobile application, rather than raw data.

questions.stem: Which revenue method sells prediction and forecasting using complex machine learning models?
options: Data as a Service
Insight as a Service
Master Data Management
Analytics as a Service
Data Governance
questions.explanation: Analytics as a Service, with prediction and forecasting, can be sold using complex ML models.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a method of generating or increasing revenue from data?
options: Reducing operational cost through proper data management
Selling customers' personal details to advertisers
Providing quality data to marketing and sales to generate more business
Data as a Service via API
Analytics as a Service with prediction and forecasting
questions.explanation: Selling personal details is prohibited by regulation; the listed methods are cost reduction, quality data for departments, Data as a Service, Insight as a Service and Analytics as a Service.

questions.stem: What does I Am Datapedia! predict about the future of Data Monetisation?
options: It will be banned by regulators
It will remain limited to social media companies
It will be replaced by advertising revenue
It will only apply to unstructured data
It will soon become the largest monetisation channel for every organisation
questions.explanation: The author expects that Data Monetisation will soon become the largest monetisation channel for every organisation.
